LoadFromCsv(ICsvSerializable, string)

Loads data from a CSV file into the object implementing ICsvSerializable.

Parameters

content ICsvSerializable

Parameters

directory DirectoryInfo

The DirectoryInfo representing the directory to search.

processor Func<Stream, T>

A function that processes each file stream and returns a result.

The search pattern to match files (default is "*").

Type Parameters

T

The type of result produced by the processor function.

ProcessDirectoryWithPaths<T>(string, Func<Stream, T>, string, bool)

Processes all files in the specified directory with their file paths using a custom processor function, suitable for large files.

public static Dictionary<string, T> ProcessDirectoryWithPaths<T>(string absolutePath, Func<Stream, T> processor, string searchPattern = "*", bool recursive = false)

Parameters

absolutePath string

The absolute path of the directory to search.

processor Func<Stream, T>

A function that processes each file stream and returns a result.

searchPattern string

The search pattern to match files (default is "*").

recursive bool

If true, searches all subdirectories; otherwise, only the top directory.

Returns

Dictionary<string, T>

A dictionary mapping file paths to their processing results, or an empty dictionary if the path is invalid or does not exist.

Type Parameters

T

The type of result produced by the processor function.

Examples

//Option 1 Using a separate method
string ReadStreamToString(Stream stream)
{
   using var reader = new StreamReader(stream);
   return reader.ReadToEnd();
}
var fileContents = ProcessAllFiles<string>(absolutePath, ReadStreamToString);

//Option 2 Using a lambda function directly
var fileContents = ProcessAllFiles<string>(absolutePath, stream =>
{
   using var reader = new StreamReader(stream);
   return reader.ReadToEnd();
});

SaveToCsv(ICsvSerializable, string)

Saves the object implementing ICsvSerializable to a CSV file at the specified path.

public static void SaveToCsv(this ICsvSerializable content, string filePath)

Parameters

content ICsvSerializable

The object to serialize and save as CSV.

filePath string

The file path where the CSV will be saved.

Remarks

Values will be saved in a single line, separated by commas. No header is included or generated, just the values are saved. This method overrides any existing file with the data supplied by ToCsv().

WriteToFile(string, string, Action<StreamWriter>, Encoding?, bool, bool)

Writes to a text file using the provided action.

public static bool WriteToFile(string path, string fileName, Action<StreamWriter> writeAction, Encoding? encoding = null, bool append = false, bool createDirectory = true)

Parameters

path string

The directory path where the file should be saved.

fileName string

The name of the file (must include a valid extension).

writeAction Action<StreamWriter>

Function that writes content using the provided StreamWriter.

encoding Encoding

The character encoding to use (null uses the default encoding).

append bool

If true, appends to the file if it exists; otherwise, overwrites it.

createDirectory bool

If true, creates the directory if it doesn't exist.

Returns

bool

True if the write operation succeeded; otherwise, false.

Exceptions

ArgumentException

Thrown when the filename has no valid extension.
